\begin{example} \end{example}[Euclidean space]

↗ def:dc-ch1-2-1

1. ch1:2.4On $\mathbb {R}^n$, identify $\frac{\partial }{\partial x_i}$ with the standard basis vector $e_i$ and set $\langle e_i,e_j\rangle =\delta _{ij}$. This is Euclidean space of dimension $n$ with its standard Riemannian metric. \end{example}
